headlines.text: Turning the clock back to 2024: Mark Briscoe vs. The Butcher locked horns for the first time, kicking off the show on Rampage, rated 5.77.
It was 2024 when Private Party vs. MxM Collection closed out Rampage, rated 6.22 in a hard-hitting tag team clash.
On this day in 2024, Anna Jay vs. Trish Adora met for the very first time on Rampage, rated 5.41.
